lead: I build structured creative workflows that actually ship—balancing clear KPIs, smart resource allocation, and consistent brand quality in fast-moving corporate environments.
points: I don’t manage purely from the sidelines. When timelines get tight or bandwidth runs low, I jump straight into the work to clear bottlenecks and keep quality high without burning out the team.
Visual storytelling with a business lens
Good design has a job to do. I translate marketing briefs into cohesive visual systems that stay true to brand strategy across digital, print, and live touchpoints.
Beyond brand and campaign work, I design web and app interfaces in Figma—building clean layouts, reusable components, and digital products that feel unmistakably on-brand.

AI is part of my everyday toolkit, from concepting and image generation to video editing and production automation. I work across Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini depending on the task, constantly testing new tools to help my team move faster without compromising craft.

dai-ichi-life-vietnam.text: I lead visual execution aligned with business and marketing goals—shaping key visuals, directing suppliers, and keeping every touchpoint consistent across internal and external channels.

sunrise-events-vietnam.text: Led brand identity and event visuals for Vietnam’s flagship endurance races, including IRONMAN Vietnam, the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon, Sunrise Sprint, and LANDMARK 81 Race to the Summit. Managed everything from key visuals and race-day signage to on-site photo/video direction, vendor coordination, and client pitches.

cen-group-rising-star-media.text: Led the design team at Rising Star Media, building new brand identities and campaign key visuals for client projects. Directed suppliers and collaborated closely with digital, event, merchandise, and marketing teams from initial concept to client presentation.

laguna-lang-co.text: Managed the resort’s digital asset library and led the in-house graphic team under Banyan Tree Hotels & Resorts brand guidelines. Oversaw concepts, timelines, budgets, and junior designer mentoring while unifying Laguna Lăng Cô’s brand identity into a single cohesive system.

nam-long-group.text: Served as corporate design lead for Nam Long Investment Corporation—creating project brand identities, campaign key visuals, and corporate event design. Directed external vendors and guided projects from initial concept through final delivery.

thien-minh-hospitality-thien-minh-group.text: Led design execution across hospitality, aviation, and travel brands, taking work from early sketches and storyboards to final production. Managed designers across Victoria Hotels & Resorts (eight resorts, cruises, coach, and express train), EMM Hotel & Resorts, L'Azalee Cruise, Lady Hau Cruise, iVivu, and Hai Au Aviation.

freelancer.text: Selected independent projects across medical, F&B, real estate, and service brands—covering brand identity systems, pitch decks, and website UI design.

about: Open, energetic, and grounded in logic. Clear structure and disciplined time management are how I keep complex, multi-stakeholder projects moving smoothly.
High-trust and outcome-driven. I work comfortably with minimal supervision and focus on guiding multidisciplinary teams—across design, photo, video, events, and digital—toward clear goals.
Curious by nature and quick to adopt new tools. I treat AI as a practical amplifier in a modern creative workflow, while keeping brand taste, judgement, and the final call firmly with the designer.
